out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the at the front serving station has been changed to a dump sink is no longer available to employees for hand washing. There is no hand washing sink at the front serving area, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Also, the hand washing sink located at the ware washing are is no longer available. It has been removed , and there is no longer available hand washing sink located available at this location. This violation was observed previously and the manager was advised to reinstall the missing sink from the ware washing station.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Reinstate the sink for hand washing as it was originally intended. Provide a means for dumping but not at this hand sink. The hand sink is to be used only for hand washing.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at front serving area handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the front serving area handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: unsalted butter held at room temperature =79F, smoked salmon=43F, Strawberry cream cheese=43F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discarded unsalted butter, removed doubling container, and place in walk-in freezer for rapid cooling. Do not use double pans to hold foods on the refrigerated prep tables, for proper cold-holding.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under stationary equipment at the front serving station , and the floor drains throughout, are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
